download_dataset_coco: download the COCO 2017 dataset to a specified directory with unzip and threading support
download_dataset_voc: download the VOC 2007 and VOC 2012 datasets with optional unzip and delete of zip files
download_dataset_objects365v2: download the Objects365v2 dataset with patch-based URL expansion and multi-threaded extraction
download_dataset_ade20k: download the ADE20K 2016 dataset including training images, annotations, and category mappings
download_dataset_refcoco: download the RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg datasets along with COCO 2014 training images
